messages.subject: Reset sidebar controls to default values
parts:
Is there a way to include a button in sidebar that would clear out all existing values 
in the various sidebar controls to their original default
 values?

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: Re: Reset sidebar controls to default values
parts:
Refreshing the webpage should work. If you want a button add the following to sidebarPanel in ui.R:

HTML("<a class='btn' href='/'>Refresh</a>")
